channel.title: BetterCloud incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from BetterCloud's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Suspended BambooHR Integrations [resolved]
item.description: We have remediated the issue that resulted in the suspension of a limited number of Bamboo HR integrations. We advise any customer utilizing the Bamboo HR Integration within BetterCloud User Automation to check the Integration Center and manually reconnect as needed using the directions in our help center article. We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. If you have any questions, please reach out to our Support team by emailing support@bettercloud.com.

item.title: Live Chat Outage [resolved]
item.description: The issue with our Chat service has been restored. We appreciate your patience! If you have any questions, please contact Support: support@bettercloud.com

item.title: Suspended O365 Integrations [resolved]
item.description: We have remediated the issue that resulted in the suspension of a limited number of Office 365 integrations. BetterCloud was able to automatically reconnect a subset of customer affected Integrations. However, we advise any customer utilizing the Office 365 Integration within BetterCloud User Automation to check the Integration Center and manually reconnect as needed using the directions in our help center article. We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. If you have any questions, please reach out to our Support team by emailing support@bettercloud.com.

item.title: Workflow/Action UI Outage [resolved]
item.description:
We have monitored for stability and concluded this issue is resolved.
This incident prevented the Workflow's UI and the Action menu from loading correctly. Further analysis showed this incident caused a delay for Workflows executed manually/scheduled to execute via the UI (ie: On Demand). All impacted Workflows have since processed as expected.
We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. If you have any questions, please contact our support team by emailing support@bettercloud.com.

item.title: User Automation: Certain Workflows Not Triggering [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the issue preventing certain Workflows from triggering. All Workflows that were expected to trigger during the outage have been reprocessed. Thank you for your patience and understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to support@bettercloud.com

item.title: Workflow/Action Delays [resolved]
item.description: We have implemented a fix for the issue causing delays in action execution for a subset of customers. We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. If you have any questions, please contact our Support Team at support@bettercloud.com.

item.title: Workflow email notifications are not sending [resolved]
File Governance - Insights Data [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the issue affecting certain customers that was resulting in a File Governance insights data issue. We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. If you have any questions, please contact our Support Team at support@bettercloud.com.

item.title: Workflow Action Delays [resolved]
item.description: We have implemented a fix that was causing Workflow Action delays for a subset of customers. We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. If you have any questions, please contact our Support Team at support@bettercloud.com.

item.title: Actions, Integrations, and Self Service Agent delays [resolved]
Google Administration (g.bettercloud.com) Outage [resolved]
item.description: Some users experienced errors when when attempting to access BetterCloud Google Administration (g.bettercloud.com) between approximately 6pm ET on 12/3 and 1am ET on 12/4. The issue has been corrected and access has been restored. A related issue causing certain tasks including signature policies, sheet imports/exports, and reports to take longer than expected was fixed today. If you have any questions, please contact our Support Team.
